photography.title: Photography
photography.intro: Photography is my way of telling stories without words. Every image I capture carries an emotion, a moment, a memory that reaches beyond what the eye can see.
photography.passion: My passion lies in capturing authentic moments—whether it's an intimate portrait, a breathtaking landscape, or a candid street shot. I believe in finding beauty in simplicity and creating images that resonate with the soul.
photography.style: My style is characterized by natural light, honest compositions, and a focus on what's real. I love working with people who want to show their story as it truly is—without embellishment, but with character and depth.
photography.quote: "A good photograph is one that makes you feel, think, and want to keep looking. It's a moment frozen in time, but alive in emotion."

it.title: IT & Development
it.intro: Beyond photography, I have a strong passion for technology and web development. I love building things from scratch and bringing ideas to life through code—it's another form of creativity.
it.website: This website was entirely coded by me using modern web technologies. I built it as a React application using:
it.blend: Combining my technical skills with my creative background allows me to create unique digital experiences that are both beautiful and functional. Code is art, just like photography.

music.title: Abstract Music
music.intro: Music is my third form of expression. I'm fascinated by abstract and experimental music—sounds that push boundaries, challenge conventions, and explore new sonic landscapes.
music.exploration: From ambient to glitch, from drone to IDM, from noise to electroacoustic—I find inspiration in music that challenges, that asks for active listening, and that creates space for personal interpretation and discovery.
music.connection: This love for abstract music also influences my photography work in subtle ways. Both art forms are about capturing mood, texture, and emotion in unconventional ways—about making the invisible visible.
music.quote: "In abstraction, we find space to create our own meaning. What's chaos to one is perfect harmony to another."

hike.title: Hiking & Nature
hike.intro: Hiking and being in nature is another passion of mine. It allows me to disconnect from the hustle and bustle of daily life and reconnect with the natural world.
hike.exploration: Exploring trails, mountains, and forests not only provides physical exercise but also inspires my creativity. The beauty of nature often finds its way into my photography, influencing my perspective and approach.
hike.connection: Spending time outdoors helps me recharge and gain new insights, which I then bring back to my work—whether it's through photography, coding, or music.
hike.quote: "Nature is not a place to visit. It is home."
